system.notes: Those Legionnaires who are able to learn Dynamism are often taught to always be prepared, and always be sure of themselves, even when unarmed. By concentrating, a spear or sword comprised of glowing energy forms in their hands or the hands of any chosen target within range. The weapon is functionally the same as a Hoplite Infantry Xiphos (DR 10) or a Spartan Infantry Spear (DR 7).
